description: Header file defining the VideoRendererImpl class, which manages video rendering, decoding, and synchronization in a media playback pipeline for the starboard platform.

classes.name: VideoRendererImpl
classes.description: Implements the VideoRenderer interface, managing video decoding, rendering, and synchronization.

methods.name: VideoRendererImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the video renderer with decoder, media time provider, algorithm, and sink.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the renderer with error, prerolled, and ended callbacks.

methods.name: GetDroppedFrames
methods.description: Returns the number of dropped frames from the algorithm.

methods.name: WriteSamples
methods.description: Feeds input buffers (video samples) into the renderer.

methods.name: IsEndOfStreamWritten
methods.description: Checks if end of stream has been written.

methods.name: CanAcceptMoreData
methods.description: Checks if renderer can accept more input data.

methods.name: OnDecoderStatus
methods.description: Handles status updates from the decoder.
